columns.title: Invoice columns
columns.description: The columns of the invoice's lines, in this order: item, sku, quantity, unitPrice, discount, tax, amount, and field.<slug> for a product or variant field (an HS code, a material, a country of origin …). Unknown ones are left out; none left: item, quantity, unitPrice, amount.

footer.title: Footer
footer.description: Printed at the bottom of invoices and packing slips (terms, thanks). Takes {business}, {email}, {phone}, {address}, {number}, {date} and {field.<slug>} of the order's and its customer's fields.

shopperFrom.title: Shoppers get their invoice
shopperFrom.description: Placed: as soon as the order is placed. Confirmed: once it is confirmed.
